card.text: Explore Pan with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Pan orbits inside the Encke Gap of Saturn’s A ring. Its gravity helps keep the gap open. Cassini revealed a small icy body surrounded by a broad equatorial ridge.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Photographs are mapped onto the measured shape. Shadows and unreliable samples are withheld; the gray grid marks gaps.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 14 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Accuracy varies by region.
